dae_policy.open_merit: DAE applicants can apply for Engineering programs on open merit in line with the guidelines provided by the Pakistan Engineering Council (PEC) for relevant technologies.

pre_medical_additional_maths.policy: A Pre-medical student appearing in Additional Mathematics (result awaiting) can apply for Engineering programs. In the online admission form, they must input their F.Sc Part-1 marks and submit an Affidavit on stamp paper stating they appeared in the Additional Maths exam before applying.
